shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك الأنصاري

notes: «وقال غيره» opens a second route (unnamed «غيره», then Layth). Both routes stop at Jaʿfar; the names after him are written once, after the second route, so they are read as the tail of both. The first route has no names of its own after Jaʿfar: a reading choice, not a rule settled by the text.
